He also laid the foundation stone for a new expressway project connecting Karachi Port to Qayyumabad. **Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah** highlighted the expressway's six interchanges, lanes, and elevated section, emphasizing its potential to reduce travel time by an hour. **Bilawal Bhutto Zardari** emphasized the PPP's commitment to public-private partnerships in developing Karachi and Pakistan, citing projects worth billions of rupees underway. He also announced plans for a Sindh International Financial Centre and a defense production zone in Karachi.

recent_articles.title: Anmol alias Pinky sent to jail on judicial remand in narcotics, murder cases - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anmol**, also known as Pinky, an alleged drug queenpin, was sent to jail on a 14-day judicial remand in multiple narcotics cases and a murder case.  She had already been booked in over a dozen criminal cases prior to her arrest earlier this month. **Karachi police** sought the Sindh government's permission to dispatch a team to Punjab to arrest Anmol’s brothers, ex-husbands, and other co-suspects involved in the drug trafficking network. A Lahore court allowed an FIR against **Rana Muhammad Akram**, Anmol’s former husband, who allegedly conducted an illegal raid on Yasmeen Tabassam's house.

recent_articles.title: Slow-moving bands of heavy rain trigger flooding and landslides in parts of China | China | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Heavy rainfall across southern and central China has led to flash flooding, landslides, and waterlogging. The **Bay of Bengal**, **South China Sea**, and **Pacific Ocean** contributed to the prolonged downpour that caused 12 deaths and forced evacuations.  Meanwhile, extreme heat warnings have been issued for northern India, with temperatures exceeding 40°C (104°F) in several regions. These conditions are expected to persist until Wednesday when thunderstorms may develop.

recent_articles.title: Nifty Bank rises 650 points as report says RBI unlikely to hike rates to defend rupee; Axis, ICICI, HDFC shares jump up to 2% - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** is considering various options to address inflation, which remains subdued despite the rupee's recent decline.  While **the RBI** has stated it will prioritize inflation over currency defense, economists at Standard Chartered predict rate hikes as early as June, citing rising crude prices. Interest rate swap markets are pricing in significant rate increases by **the RBI**, with some predicting a 50 basis point hike in June and more than 100 basis points over the next year.  **The RBI's** decision on whether to raise rates will be announced on June 5th, following its second meeting since the Iran-US conflict began.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Imran’s cases will be fixed after Eid, CJP assures PTI - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Justice of Pakistan (CJP) Yahya Afridi** assured **PTI General Secretary Salman Akram Raja** that the cases concerning access to a personal physician, family members and counsel for former premier Imran Khan would be scheduled after Eidul Azha.  Raja reported that the CJP had issued instructions to senior officers of the Supreme Court to fix these petitions. The PTI general secretary also stated that the appeals regarding Imran's access were pending before the SC since October 2025, and a petition by Imran's sister challenging the IHC ruling was also pending.  The **Supreme Court** disposed of appeals filed by the Punjab prosecution seeking cancellation of bail granted to **Ejaz Ahmed Chaudhry**, involved in the May 9 cases.

recent_articles.title: Patient tests HIV-positive after surgery, triggering probe at Multan’s Nishtar Hospital - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nishtar Hospital** in Multan, **Pakistan**, has formed a four-member inquiry committee to investigate allegations of medical negligence following a patient's surgery without mandatory HIV screening. The patient tested positive for the virus after the procedure and raised concerns among staff about potential exposure and lapses in infection control protocols.  The hospital claims that preventive measures were taken immediately, including disinfection of surgical instruments. **Dr Riwad Noor**, a member of the inquiry committee, stated they will submit their report within two days.

recent_articles.title: Sialkot authorities on alert as India opens spillway gates of dam on Chenab River - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sialkot Deputy Commissioner Saba Asghar** issued a high alert for the Chenab River following an advisory from **India** warning of potential emergency silt flushing at the Indian Salal Dam. The rising water level has prompted restrictions on movement along the river and its banks, with authorities urging citizens to avoid unnecessary visits to rivers and canals.  Asghar also activated the District Emergency Control Room and directed all relevant departments to monitor the situation 24/7.

recent_articles.title: Punjab govt imposes Section 144 around airports, PAF bases for 30 days - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Punjab**'s government has implemented a 30-day ban on pigeon homing, laser light usage by businesses, and meat disposal near airports and **Pakistan Air Force** bases. The order, issued under Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), aims to prevent disruptions to public peace, safety, and tranquility.  The ban is effective immediately and applies within a 13km radius around all PAF bases and commercial airports in the province.

recent_articles.title: Punjab govt bans activities 'injurious to public health, peace' ahead of Eidul Azha - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Punjab** government has issued a notification prohibiting several activities deemed harmful to public health and peace during Eidul Azha, from May 27th to June 2nd. The restrictions include banning the burning of animal heads and feet, swimming in rivers or canals, and illegal sale of sacrificial animals outside designated markets. These measures aim to prevent unsanitary conditions, traffic disruptions, and potential public health risks associated with Eidul Azha celebrations.

recent_articles.title: SC issues notices to accused in Rawalpindi honour killing case after jirga rejects woman’s marriage choice - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** of Pakistan issued notices to the accused in an honor killing case involving a young woman from Rawalpindi who was murdered after a jirga rejected her choice of marriage. The case stems from an FIR filed by Zia-ur Rehman, alleging his wife's elopement with another man and subsequent murder at the behest of a jirga. **Zafarullah** and **Rafaqat Mehmood**, members of the jirga who were granted bail by the Lahore High Court, are among those facing charges. The Punjab Prosecution Department appealed against the high court's decision, arguing that the accused were fully involved in the crime and posed a threat to witnesses. The case was adjourned until June.

recent_articles.title: Alleged drug queenpin Anmol remanded into police custody till May 22 in narcotics case - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **judicial magistrate** in Karachi remanded alleged drug queenpin Anmol alias Pinky into police custody until May 22nd.  She was arrested earlier this week for possession of narcotics and an unlicensed weapon, and is already facing multiple criminal charges. The **police** sought her physical custody in a total of 15 cases but were denied in most instances, with some being sent to judicial remand. Anmol claimed she was tortured during custody and that the police are trying to harass her in court.  The investigation into her alleged drug network is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Sindh lifts curbs on market timings; minister says step taken to facilitate businesses, citizens - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharjeel Memon**, **Sindh Senior Minister**, announced the exemption of shops, markets, malls, hotels, restaurants, wedding halls and marquees from fixed closing timings to support businesses and citizens.  The decision comes after the Sindh government previously enforced a 9pm closing time last month as part of austerity measures amid the Middle East conflict. This follows similar decisions by **Punjab** and federal governments to adjust market closure times in response to energy conservation concerns.

recent_articles.title: Punjab relaxes market timing curbs till June 1 - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: In response to public and business concerns, the **Punjab** government has lifted the 8pm business closure timings for markets and shopping malls until June 1st. The decision comes after protests from traders and appeals by the shopping malls association and general public.  The **Lahore Chamber of Commerce and Industry** welcomed the move as a "business-friendly" step, while **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa** Governor Faisal Karim Kundi and Chief Minister Sohail Afridi agreed to ease lockdown restrictions in their province.
